gloss: power distribution line; electrical distribution line

definitions.gloss: power distribution line; electrical distribution line
definitions.explanation: The electrical lines that carry power from substations to homes and buildings. These are the lower-voltage lines commonly seen running along streets on utility poles, as distinct from high-voltage transmission lines.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{配電線|はいでんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
examples.english: The distribution line was severed by the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {配電線|はいでんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一時的|いちじてき}→一時的：05846_ichijiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: There will be a temporary power outage due to distribution line work.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{配電|はいでん}→配電：30069_haiden⟧ (power distribution) and ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line, wire). In the electrical grid, power flows from generators through ⟦{送電線|そうでんせん}→送電線：09776_soudensen⟧ (transmission lines) to substations, then through {配電線|はいでんせん} (distribution lines) to end users. The distribution lines are the ones most visible in daily life, running along ⟦{電柱|でんちゅう}→電柱：17913_denchuu⟧ (utility poles).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配電線|はいでんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧: repair of distribution lines
- {配電線|はいでんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{地中化|ちちゅうか}: undergrounding of distribution lines
- {配電線|はいでんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{断線|だんせん}→断線：20692_dansen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a distribution line breaks
- ⟦{高圧|こうあつ}→高圧：21094_kouatsu⟧{配電線|はいでんせん}: high-voltage distribution line

- ⟦{電線|でんせん}→電線：11507_densen⟧: electrical wire — the general term for any electrical cable
